liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Saint Stephen** (2 reviews): After Hamza's meltdown segment, the band tears into St. Stephen and then Not Fade Away; Reviewer calls the introduction to St. Stephen the best ever [18][22]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Reviewer singles out They Love Each Other as nice on the audience recording [24]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Donna's singing on Looks Like Rain took the reviewer back three decades [15]
- **I Need A Miracle** (1 review): Second set opens with I Need A Miracle and runs as a continuous, fast-paced stretch with no slow songs [13]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Bertha into Good Lovin' is praised for its great energy [18]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Playing In The Band flows into Shakedown Street, Drums, Ollin Arrageed, Space, and St. Stephen in one sequence [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Ollin Arrageed**: rare: 14 archived performances [25]

## The recordings

- **gd78-12-30.sbd.miller.18092.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 27 songs; 218 min; rated 4.38/5 by 39 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer counts about four audio blips in the recording; Reviewer finds the recording quality poor; Reviewer says fans are too harsh on these soundboards and had sought a board of this show for 20 years [14][15][19]
- **gd1978-12-30.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-18092.34261.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 27 songs; 217 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1978-12-30.145350.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 27 songs; 220 min [5]
- **gd78-12-30.aud-schug.warner.19417.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 27 songs; 213 min; rated 4.46/5 by 13 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience recording described as great, with the energy of the Pauley Pavilion crowd audible [24]
- **gd1978-12-30.sbd.tonyg.8826.shnf**: soundboard; 27 songs; 210 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [10]

## Around the show

- Band sounded giddy and energetic from the start; second set is continuous beginning with I Need A Miracle [15]
- Hamza El Din joins during the drums segment; reviewer notes the show lacks an Eyes of the World encore [18]
- One More Saturday Night was the encore; Mama Tried segued into Mexicali Blues [1]
- Hamza el-Din performs percussion and vocals on Ollin Arrageed [5]
- Ollin Arrageed features Hamza el-Din [10]
- Reviewer considers this one of the better 1978 shows, with a range of emotions and fiery energy [17]
- Show is seen as overlooked, given that Winterland closed the following night [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-12-30.sbd.miller.18092.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Reviewer had a first- or second-generation copy in 1983, since lost; Soundboard transferred through reel, cassette and DAT, with audience patches supplied via Charlie Miller [1][17]
- **gd1978-12-30.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-18092.34261.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Fix of shnid 18092 [3]. Also: Transition between CDs 2 and 3 made seamless using CE 2000, using overlap provided by Charlie Miller [3]
- **gd1978-12-30.145350.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-270 mics (left side, first row of seats above bleachers next to railing, even with the soundboard) > Sony… [5]. Also: Neumann source patches 14 seconds in Fire On The Mountain and 12 seconds in Ollin Arrageed [5]
- **gd78-12-30.aud-schug.warner.19417.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Greg Schug; source: Audience Recording: 2 Neumann KM84 mics [6]
- **gd1978-12-30.sbd.tonyg.8826.shnf**: transferred by Tony G; source: SBD > MR > PCM > DAT > CDR [10]. Also: Splices in Stagger Lee and Playin' leave gaps of about 10 seconds and 2 minutes of vocals respectively [10]
